name: Garden spade
definition: long-handled tool with a flat, sharp-edged blade pushed in by foot to dig and cut soil.

name: Garden fork
definition: long-handled tool with stout tines to dig, loosen and turn soil.

name: Shovel
definition: long-handled tool with a broad, dished blade to lift and move loose soil or material.

name: Mattock
definition: swung tool with a heavy head carrying an adze blade, used to break hard ground and cut roots.

name: Hand trowel
definition: short-handled scoop-shaped blade for digging small planting holes.

name: Bulb planter
definition: tool that cuts and lifts a plug of soil to make a hole for a bulb.

name: Hoe
definition: long-handled tool with a blade drawn or pushed through the soil surface to weed and loosen it.

name: Hand cultivator
definition: tined tool, hand-held or on a handle, that breaks up and aerates the soil surface.

name: Garden rake
definition: rake with short rigid teeth on a straight head to level and break soil.

name: Garden sieve
definition: framed mesh riddle that sifts soil or compost.

name: Secateurs
definition: One-handed scissor-action pruning shears for stems and small branches, manual or powered; bypass, anvil and ratchet are the cutting actions.

name: Loppers
definition: long-handled two-handed pruning shears for thicker branches.

name: Pruning saw
definition: hand saw with a toothed blade made to cut living branches.

name: Pole pruner
definition: pruning head on a long pole, worked from the ground to cut high branches.

name: Chainsaw
definition: Hand-held saw with a powered toothed chain running round a guide bar, for felling, pruning and cutting wood; petrol, cordless or corded.

name: Pole saw
definition: Powered saw head on a long pole for cutting high branches from the ground.

name: Hedge shears
definition: two-handed long-bladed shears for clipping hedges and shrubs.

name: Hedge trimmer
definition: powered tool with a reciprocating toothed blade bar for cutting hedges.

name: Sickle
definition: one-handed curved blade for cutting grass and crops.

name: Scythe
definition: long-shafted two-handed tool with a long curved blade swung to mow grass.

name: Brush cutter
definition: powered shaft machine with a metal blade or line head for clearing brush, scrub and long grass.

name: Billhook
definition: hooked chopping blade on a short handle for cutting brush, hedge laying and coppice work.

name: Machete
definition: long heavy-bladed knife swung to cut vegetation.

name: Garden multi-tool
definition: Powered handle and motor unit that takes interchangeable cutting attachments such as a grass trimmer, hedge trimmer, pole pruner or brush cutter.

name: Cylinder mower
definition: mower that cuts with a rotating reel of blades against a fixed bottom blade.

name: Rotary mower
definition: wheeled mower that cuts with a blade spinning horizontally under a deck.

name: Hover mower
definition: rotary mower that floats on a cushion of air instead of wheels.

name: Robotic mower
definition: Self-guided battery mower that mows a set area on its own.

name: Ride-on mower
definition: mower that carries its seated operator while it cuts.

name: Lawn tractor
definition: Lawn or garden tractor with a mowing deck but no rear power take-off and no large three-point hitch; one with both is in Farm & Forestry Equipment.

name: String trimmer
definition: powered tool that cuts grass at lawn edges and around obstacles with a spinning line or light blade.

name: Scarifier
definition: machine or tool that rakes thatch and moss out of a lawn with blades or tines.

name: Broadcast spreader
definition: wheeled or hand-held hopper that spreads seed or granular feed over a lawn.

name: Lawn roller
definition: weighted drum pushed or pulled to firm and level a lawn.

name: Lawn aerator
definition: tool or machine that spikes or cores a lawn to let air and water into the soil.

name: Artificial turf
definition: synthetic grass surface sold in rolls or tiles to lay as a lawn.

name: Garden stone
definition: Stone, gravel included, and bark sold as decorative ground cover.

name: Leaf rake
definition: wide fan-shaped rake with springy tines for gathering leaves and debris.

name: Leaf blower
definition: Powered machine that blows leaves and debris into heaps; a blower-vac that also sucks and shreds is the same machine with a vacuum function.

name: Garden shredder
definition: machine that shreds garden prunings and green waste into small pieces.

name: Wood chipper
definition: Chipper for branches and brush that is not tractor-driven, towed or self-propelled, for tree surgery and grounds work.

name: Pressure washer
definition: powered pump that sprays water at high pressure to clean paths, drives, patios and vehicles.

name: Wheelbarrow
definition: Wheeled container with handles for carrying soil, waste and materials in a garden; a garden cart is the same thing.

name: Snow shovel
definition: wide-bladed hand shovel or pusher for clearing snow.

name: Snow blower
definition: powered machine that gathers snow and throws it clear of a path or drive.

name: Garden hose
definition: flexible hose for carrying water in a garden.

name: Hose reel
definition: reel or cart on which a garden hose is wound and stored.

name: Lawn sprinkler
definition: Device that sprays water over an area of lawn or bed; pop-up, oscillating and rotary heads are all sold.

name: Drip irrigation kit
definition: Set of pipe, drippers and fittings that delivers water drop by drop to plants; balcony and terrace sets come in different sizes.

name: Soaker hose
definition: porous hose that seeps water along its length into the soil.

name: Irrigation controller
definition: timer or controller that switches the water supply to a garden irrigation system.

name: Watering can
definition: hand-carried vessel with a spout, often with a rose, for watering plants.

name: Garden water pump
definition: Pump made to move water for watering and irrigation in a garden.

name: Pond pump
definition: Pump made to circulate water in a garden pond, fountain or water feature.

name: Water butt
definition: Container that collects and stores rainwater for garden use.

name: Pond liner
definition: Flexible waterproof sheet laid to form a garden pond.

name: Preformed pond
definition: Rigid moulded pond shell set into the ground.

name: Plant pot
definition: container with drainage in which a plant grows.

name: Window box
definition: long narrow planter made to sit on or hang from a window sill or railing.

name: Hanging basket
definition: basket or container hung from a bracket or chain to grow plants in.

name: Bonsai pot
definition: shallow glazed or unglazed pot with drainage and wire holes, made for growing bonsai.

name: Fabric grow pot
definition: pot made of breathable fabric that air-prunes roots.

name: Plant saucer
definition: shallow dish set under a pot to catch drained water.

name: Cachepot
definition: Decorative outer container without drainage that holds a potted plant.

name: Self-watering planter
definition: planter with a built-in reservoir that feeds water to the roots.

name: Raised bed
definition: framed bed standing above ground level, filled with soil to grow plants in.

name: Plant stake
definition: rod or cane pushed into the soil to hold up a plant.

name: Plant tie
definition: tie, twine or clip that fastens a plant to its support.

name: Plant label
definition: tag or marker that names a plant in a pot or bed.

name: Plant netting
definition: Netting made to support climbing plants or protect crops from birds and pests.

name: Horticultural fleece
definition: light non-woven fabric laid over plants to protect them from frost and pests.

name: Cloche
definition: small transparent cover placed over plants to shelter and warm them.

name: Trellis
definition: Open lattice panel on which climbing plants are trained.

name: Garden arch
definition: Arched frame over a path on which climbing plants are grown.

name: Obelisk
definition: Free-standing tapering frame on which climbing plants are grown.

name: Potting compost
definition: prepared growing medium for pots and containers.

name: Mulch
definition: Material spread on the soil surface to hold moisture and suppress weeds; bark mulch included.

name: Topsoil
definition: screened upper soil sold for beds, lawns and filling.

name: Soil improver
definition: Material dug into soil to improve its structure or fertility.

name: Fertiliser
definition: product that supplies plant nutrients, granular, liquid or slow-release.

name: Herbicide
definition: Weed killer made to kill or control unwanted plants.

name: Insecticide
definition: Product that kills or repels insects and other pests on plants.

name: Fungicide
definition: product that prevents or treats fungal disease on plants.

name: Garden sprayer
definition: hand-pumped or powered sprayer for applying liquid feeds and plant-protection products.

name: Soil test kit
definition: kit for testing garden soil for pH or nutrients.

name: Compost bin
definition: container in which garden and kitchen waste is composted.

name: Greenhouse
definition: glazed framed structure in which plants are grown under shelter.

name: Polytunnel
definition: hoop-framed tunnel covered in polythene film for growing plants under cover.

name: Cold frame
definition: low glazed box that shelters plants and seedlings outdoors.

name: Grow light
definition: Lamp made to give light for plant growth; LED, HPS, CMH and fluorescent are the lamp technologies.

name: Grow tent
definition: lightproof reflective fabric tent on a frame for growing plants indoors under lights.

name: Propagator
definition: covered tray, heated or not, for raising seeds and cuttings.

name: Hydroponic system
definition: system that grows plants without soil, roots fed by a nutrient solution.

name: Above-ground pool
definition: framed swimming pool that stands on the ground.

name: Soft-sided pool
definition: Swimming pool with flexible walls, held up by an inflatable ring or by the water.

name: Pool pump
definition: pump that circulates pool water through the filter.

name: Sand filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt in a bed of sand or glass media.

name: Cartridge filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt in a pleated cartridge.

name: DE filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt on grids coated with diatomaceous earth.

name: Salt chlorinator
definition: device that makes chlorine from salt dissolved in the pool water by electrolysis.

name: Pool heater
definition: gas, electric or solar heater that warms pool water.

name: Pool heat pump
definition: Heat pump that warms pool water with heat drawn from the air.

name: Robotic pool cleaner
definition: self-powered cleaner with its own motor that scrubs and vacuums the pool.

name: Suction-side pool cleaner
definition: cleaner driven by the suction of the pool pump.

name: Pressure-side pool cleaner
definition: cleaner driven by water pressure from the pool's return line or a booster pump.

name: Pool cover
definition: cover laid over a pool to keep out debris, hold heat or make it safe.

name: Pool test kit
definition: Kit for testing pool water for chlorine, pH and other values.

name: Pool sanitiser
definition: Chemical that disinfects pool water, chlorine tablets and granules included.

name: Mower blade
definition: Replacement cutting blade made for a mower.

name: Trimmer line
definition: Replacement cutting line made for a string trimmer or brush cutter head.

name: Pool filter cartridge
definition: Replacement pleated element made for a pool cartridge filter.

name: Pruning knife
definition: fixed or folding knife with a curved or straight blade made to cut stems, prune and graft plants.

name: Hand weeder
definition: short-handled tool with a forked or notched blade that levers tap-rooted weeds out of soil or paving joints.

name: Dibber
definition: pointed hand tool pushed into soil to make holes for seeds, seedlings and cuttings.

name: Tree watering bag
definition: bag filled with water and strapped round a tree trunk that releases water slowly into the root zone.

name: Stump grinder
definition: machine with a toothed cutting wheel that grinds tree stumps below ground, not tractor-driven.

name: Scythe blade
definition: Replacement blade made to fit a scythe snath.

name: Scythe snath
definition: Shaft with grips made to carry a scythe blade, sold alone.

name: Vertical garden planter
definition: wall-hung or stacked pocket or module system in which plants grow in a vertical surface.

name: Hanging basket liner
definition: coir, moss or fibre liner made to line a wire hanging basket or planter, sold alone.

name: Plant support frame
definition: wire or plastic cage, ring or grow-through grid that holds up a whole plant or clump.

name: Plant tying tool
definition: hand tool that wraps tape round a stem and its support and staples it.

name: Compost-filled grow bag
definition: plastic sack of growing medium laid flat and planted into directly.

name: Pool cleaner booster pump
definition: pump that raises water pressure to drive a pressure-side pool cleaner.

name: Robotic pool skimmer
definition: self-powered, often solar, floating robot that skims debris from the water surface.

name: DE filter grid
definition: Replacement grid or grid set made for a pool DE filter.

name: Grow environment controller
definition: controller that switches lights, fans and humidity devices of a grow tent or room on set values.

name: Garden snips
definition: scissor-form shears with finger loops and straight blades for herbs, flowers and soft stems.

name: Half-moon edger
definition: long-handled tool with a flat half-moon blade pushed in by foot to cut a clean lawn edge.

name: Broadfork
definition: two-handled wide fork with long tines, rocked back to loosen soil deeply without turning it.

name: Grass shears
definition: shears with short blades, one-handed or on long handles, for trimming grass at lawn edges by hand.

name: Garden tiller
definition: powered machine with rotating tines that digs and breaks up soil for beds and plots.

name: Hose spray gun
definition: hand-held nozzle or gun fitted to a hose end to shape and stop the water jet for hand watering.

name: Hose connector
definition: click-on or screw connector, tap connector or coupling that joins garden hoses to taps, tools and each other.
